key_idea: Binary search the maximum allowed frequency c; for a fixed c fill the remaining stripes greedily, always using the colour with the most remaining capacity among colours not used in the previous p-1 stripes.
sketch: First check the given prefix: if any colour repeats within p positions the answer is impossible. For a cap c, each colour has remaining capacity c minus its prefix count; keep a max-heap of currently allowed colours keyed by remaining capacity, pop the top for each new stripe, and re-insert the colour used at position i-p when reaching position i (it leaves the forbidden window then).
